title: Book 5: Burnout Hiatus, Our Own Frequency & Neon on the Huckleberry Trail (2005–2016)
description: Quiet years at home on Progress Street NE: recording 2008's intimate acoustic living-room album Our Own Frequency, becoming $30/month non-resident members at the Town of Christiansburg's Blue Ridge Regional Aquatic Center, turning down a $150,000,000 corporate catalog buyout, getting the inspiration for 'Neon on the Huckleberry Trail' in October 2014, and rolling into Room 518 in Richmond for Virginia Transit Legislative Day on February 4, 2016.
